name: Kellan
description: Kellan is a young half-fae swordsman from Eldraine, the son of the planeswalker Oko, who wields twig-hilted swords and fae magic and later works as an Agency investigator on Ravnica.

summary.text: Kellan is a young half-fae swordsman from Eldraine, the son of the planeswalker Oko, who wields twig-hilted swords and fae magic and later works as an Agency investigator on Ravnica.

bio.text: As Boldt, the first son and heir of the Duchy of Kelsh, he was taught by Enthril to ask rather than command magic.
On Eldraine he passed through an archway to meet Talion and accepted a quest in exchange for answers, hoping to learn the truth about his father.
With Ruby he fought through the witches' trials and learned from his mother that his father was Oko, then stepped through a portal hoping to find him.
On Ixalan he was rescued by Amalia, who took responsibility for him, and the two fled through the Core and later leapt through an Omenpath together.
On Ravnica he was an Agency investigator and became Kaya's partner during the Karlov Manor murders, and was thrown into the sky by Oba and saved by fae magic.
On Thunder Junction he met Oko, who accepted him as his son but then abandoned him, and Kellan joined Ral Zarek against Oko.
He took control of the dragon Akul's mind and sent him back into the collapsing vault, and then invited Amalia to Thunder Junction.

status.text: As of the latest story he is alive and is haunted by dreams from Lorwyn, finding flowers blooming from his tongue.

timeline.summary: Corsairs attack Boldt's passage ship with cannon fire.
timeline.quote: The cannonball missed him by inches.

timeline.summary: Boldt's attempted spell against a corsair fizzles.
timeline.quote: But as quickly as the spell sprang to life, it fizzled, uselessly impotent against the hull of the corsair.

timeline.summary: The corsairs' chained cannonballs cleave the mainmast, killing most of the crew.
timeline.quote: Mast, rigging, and crew came crashing down into the sterncastle and through the deck, bringing several screams to a sickening halt.

timeline.summary: Enthril tells Boldt that they are all the crew that is left.
timeline.quote: We're the crew now. All that's left.

timeline.summary: Boldt and Enthril repair the hull below deck, Enthril telling him to use the mallet.
timeline.quote: Below deck, the pungent smell of hemp fiber and pine tar filled Boldt's nostrils.

timeline.summary: Enthril reveals he graduated top of his class from the academy Boldt is bound for.
timeline.quote: Graduated top honors.

timeline.summary: Enthril tells Boldt that control is an illusion and that he has learned to be a custodian of magic.
timeline.quote: Control is the illusion.

timeline.summary: Four pirate ships close in as the drifting sail pulls the ship east; Enthril gives Boldt a scimitar to cut the lines.
timeline.quote: Four sails on the water

timeline.summary: Boldt cuts the lines freeing the mainsail, and Enthril welcomes him to the real academy.
timeline.quote: Boldt cut through weathered ropes and rigging, bringing the blade down again and again until the tattered sail pulled itself free.

timeline.summary: Enthril stops Boldt from using his focus and tells him to ask rather than command.
timeline.quote: Don't speak. Don't command. Ask .

timeline.summary: A direct hit prompts Boldt to lunge, unleashing a surge of force that knocks the lead pirate ship broadside.
timeline.quote: A voltaic surge of force lashed across fathoms of ocean to catch the vanguard upright, knocking it violently broadside to port.

timeline.summary: The ship drifts toward the Perimeter, and Enthril names the Dire Waves as the worse problem.
timeline.quote: The Dire Waves. This is what worse looks like.

timeline.summary: The buoys blaze with light, the skeletons shriek, and a giant tentacle splits the ship across its keel.
timeline.quote: The appendage crashed through the middle of the ship, splitting it across the keel to send the mages airborne

timeline.summary: The wreckage lifts on the back of an immense shelled leviathan.
timeline.quote: Beneath them, the barnacled surface of an immense shell

timeline.summary: Boldt's calculating inner voice stops, and he finally sees how to let magic flow through him.
timeline.quote: And then the voice in his head, the voice of control, suddenly, inexplicably stopped.

timeline.summary: Enthril's blazing light engulfs the mages, the wreckage, the creature and the sea.
timeline.quote: The light exploded forth—engulfing the mages, the floating scraps of ship, the creature, the sea, the world.

timeline.summary: Boldt wakes alone aboard a strange skyship floating above the Dire Waves with Enthril gone.
timeline.quote: He was on a skyship of some kind, the make of which he could only have imagined.

timeline.summary: Boldt finds Enthril's signet ring, puts it on, and lets the winds carry him away from the Tolarian Academy.
timeline.quote: He put on Enthril's ring, as a reminder.

timeline.summary: Kellan comes home bloodied by the Cotter boys, who asked whether his real father was a faerie.
timeline.quote: They asked if it was true my real dad was a faerie.

timeline.summary: Kellan's mother and stepfather say he belongs with them, but he feels longing when he looks to the woods.
timeline.quote: When he looks to the woods, all he feels is longing.

timeline.summary: On a new-moon night Kellan races Hex to the willow tree and sees a translucent archway to the faerie realm.
timeline.quote: Ahead of him there is an archway made of ethereal, translucent stone.

timeline.summary: Kellan passes through the archway before his mother can stop him.
timeline.quote: Kellan passes through the archway.

timeline.summary: Kellan meets Talion, who asks if he is true of heart and says he will answer questions in return for service.
timeline.quote: "Tell me, brave hero ... Are you true of heart?"

timeline.summary: Talion asks Kellan to defeat the three witches Agatha, Hylda and Eriette to break the Wicked Slumber in return for a boon.
timeline.quote: Whosoever is brave enough to defeat them shall break the curse upon the Realm

timeline.summary: Kellan accepts the quest hoping to learn the truth about his father.
timeline.quote: "I'll do it. I'll go."

timeline.summary: Kellan asks around Edgewall for witches and is warned by Ruby not to touch a sleeper because of the Wicked Slumber.
timeline.quote: "The Wicked Slumber spreads, though no one's really sure how,"

timeline.summary: Ruby agrees to guide Kellan to Dunbarrow in exchange for help finding her brother Peter, after he vaguely names his fae liege.
timeline.quote: "All right. I guess someone's got to look out for you, and it might as well be me."

timeline.summary: On the way they pass Phyrexian remnants and Ruby throws an apple at a laughing pixie.
timeline.quote: Ruby picks up an apple from her basket and flings it hard as a giant flinging a boulder

timeline.summary: A wolf-armored archer attacks, and Kellan and Ruby flee.
timeline.quote: The Wolf Knight strides toward them.

timeline.summary: Ruby leads Kellan through a pack of witchstalkers, who then chase off the Wolf Knight.
timeline.quote: The Wolf Knight runs into the woods as the witchstalkers give chase.

timeline.summary: They find a witch's thorny cabin and overhear her song about eating a knight.
timeline.quote: "When I was hungry a knight wandered in, wild at heart and covered in tin ..."

timeline.summary: Kellan sneaks in and charges the witch, knocking her into her cauldron.
timeline.quote: he hears her scream as she falls into the cauldron

timeline.summary: Peter helps carry the cauldron through a threshold to Talion's court, where Talion names Hylda as the next witch and the mirror Indrelon as the way to find her.
timeline.quote: "But consult the mirror Indrelon, and you may yet find her ."

timeline.summary: Ruby learns Kellan's liege is the fae king and decides to keep helping him.
timeline.quote: "You helped me find my brother, so I'll help.

timeline.summary: Kellan and Ruby climb a beanstalk with the guide Troyan, who gives them frog potions for the leap to the clouds.
timeline.quote: "Pretty cool, huh? Don't worry, it's only temporary," Troyan says.

timeline.summary: Kellan and Ruby leap to Stormkeld, the giants' castle, and slip inside while the giants waltz.
timeline.quote: "We're really here, huh?" she says. "Stormkeld."

timeline.summary: The giant Beluna's goose chases them and Beluna seizes Kellan, accusing them of trying to steal the mirror at her birthday party.
timeline.quote: "What are you doing at my party?"

timeline.summary: Lord Yorvo, apparently the Giant King, makes Kellan and his friends his guests and persuades Beluna to show them the mirror.
timeline.quote: "Consider you and yours my guests at this party."

timeline.summary: Troyan tells the mirror something new, and it shows an ice castle at Loch Larent where Hylda lies.
timeline.quote: Beneath the condensation, he sees a castle of ice, faceted and glittering

timeline.summary: Kellan and Ruby return to Edgewall to find the Slumber's violet threads spreading across the town.
timeline.quote: Now, with a sinking heart, Kellan realizes that the victims are beyond counting.

timeline.summary: Peter agrees to take them to Loch Larent, warning them to turn back if they cannot feel their noses, and Ruby promises.
timeline.quote: "You must wear my thickest cloak, and when you can no longer feel your nose, you must turn back.

timeline.summary: Peter shows them a puppet show of a girl in a red hood defeating a witch, moving Ruby.
timeline.quote: All watch in perfect stillness as two puppets triumph over all manner of trouble to defeat an evil, man-eating witch.

timeline.summary: Peter leaves them to camp as Kellan and Ruby approach Hylda's ice castle at Loch Larent.
timeline.quote: They bid farewell to Peter.

timeline.summary: Hylda's voice warns them to turn back and summons frost warriors, one pinning Kellan's cloak and another seizing Ruby.
timeline.quote: Another warrior's formed, and this one's got her in its clutches.

timeline.summary: Kellan pleads to his father and his hilts become a blade of light that cuts down the warriors' arms; he frees Ruby.
timeline.quote: his newfound sword cuts straight through the frost warrior's arm.

timeline.summary: Kellan collapses from the cold and sleepiness, and Ruby catches him.
timeline.quote: Kellan falls.

timeline.summary: Ruby carries Kellan toward the castle over Hylda's taunts, then crawls across the drawbridge past frozen bodies, refusing to abandon him.
timeline.quote: She shifts Kellan onto her back, throws her hands out ahead.

timeline.summary: Hylda appears kneeling beside Ruby and Kellan, extends a hand, clears the weather, and puts them to sleep to keep them safe.
timeline.quote: "Be welcome in Winter's Home."

timeline.summary: They wake in the ice castle where Hylda hands over her crown as proof of defeat, and the castle begins to melt.
timeline.quote: "Take that to the Kindly Lord, as proof of my defeat."

timeline.summary: Hylda reveals the witches did not create the Slumber alone and that Talion proposed Eriette's sleeping curse for a boon.
timeline.quote: Talion was the one who broke the stalemate.

timeline.summary: Kellan storms out and goes through Talion's portal with Ruby to confront him, throwing the crown at his feet.
timeline.quote: Kellan throws the crown at Talion's feet.

timeline.summary: Talion defends himself, says fae do not lie, and tells Kellan to defeat Eriette at Castle Ardenvale to learn of his father.
timeline.quote: "You shall find Eriette at Castle Ardenvale.

timeline.summary: Back outside Hylda's castle Kellan weeps.
timeline.quote: Kellan begins to weep.

timeline.summary: Kellan and Ruby ride to Castle Ardenvale on ponies and use the second frog potion to jump over its gates.
timeline.quote: They're in the air seconds later.

timeline.summary: Inside they find Rowan in the throne room studying curse notes; Kellan reads her note about attempting to put people to sleep before she knocks him out with sparks.
timeline.quote: Kellan's vision goes white.

timeline.summary: Kellan wakes in a cell, freed by Ruby, who says Rowan knocked them out and was trying to work dream magic on him when Will's army arrived.
timeline.quote: "Syr Rowan knocked us both out.

timeline.summary: Kellan and Ruby attack Eriette's throne while Rowan reveals Eriette is their aunt and begs Will to save her; Will says he doesn't know her anymore.
timeline.quote: "I don't know you anymore," he says.

timeline.summary: Kellan lashes Ashiok in place with his golden whip so Will can strike them with a bolt of ice, which makes Ashiok vanish.
timeline.quote: Ashiok lets out a howl of pain as the ice spreads through their body.

timeline.summary: Will thanks Kellan and Ruby and invites them to the palace; Kellan slips away to the Fae World.
timeline.quote: Outside of Castle Ardenvale he steps into the Fae World.

timeline.summary: Kellan returns home to Orrinshire and is reunited with Hex, Ronald and his mother, who gives him an enchanted coat.
timeline.quote: yes, after all of that, he is finally home.

timeline.summary: Kellan's mother tells him about his father, Oko, a shapeshifting being from another Realm she met while training and who wanted to raze the town after it shunned her.
timeline.quote: He told me his name was Oko

timeline.summary: Hex leads Kellan to a swirling portal in the woods and Kellan steps through, hoping to find his father.
timeline.quote: Kellan pets Hex, and steps through the portal.

timeline.summary: A strange swordsman runs toward the vampires, pursued by pale goblin-like creatures.
timeline.quote: Someone emerged from a nearby building, chased by a half-dozen smaller figures.

timeline.summary: Amalia alters her map with her enchanted quill, removing part of the bridge so the pursuers fall.
timeline.quote: With a delicate scratch of her quill, Amalia changed the map, and changed the world.

timeline.summary: The rescued man introduces himself as Kellan, from Eldraine.
timeline.quote: I'm Kellan

timeline.summary: Vito refuses to help Kellan, but Amalia takes responsibility for him and Vito grudgingly accepts.
timeline.quote: I'll take responsibility for him.

timeline.summary: The Malamet throw the Legion, one by one, into a basin of sand that drains into a hole.
timeline.quote: Bartolomé watched as the Malamet threw his comrades into the basin of sand

timeline.summary: Amalia tells Kellan to hold his breath just before sinking.
timeline.quote: Hold your breath.

timeline.summary: The Legion falls out of the sand into the same freshwater sea.
timeline.quote: Without warning, she hit water, her eyes flying open.

timeline.summary: Amalia and Kellan step through the golden door into the Core, a hollow world matching her visions.
timeline.quote: A sprawling panorama spread before, above, and around her as she stepped through the portal.

timeline.summary: The Legion is locked in empty detention rooms, weapons confiscated.
timeline.quote: Even so, the Legion vampires and their few remaining servants were locked up in empty rooms, weapons confiscated, and left to await their fates.

timeline.summary: Kellan questions the vampires, and Amalia defends the church's blood rites, then doubts.
timeline.quote: We only feed from criminals, evil people, and we use the power of blood to help others.

timeline.summary: Kellan reveals he is searching for the father he has never met.
timeline.quote: I'm searching for my father

timeline.summary: Vito demands Kellan's blood as a sacrifice to Aclazotz.
timeline.quote: The blood of the outsider will suffice

timeline.summary: Bartolomé attacks Vito to block the doorway while Kellan summons his swords.
timeline.quote: Bartolomé leaped at Vito, hands curled into claws, fangs bared.

timeline.summary: Amalia erases the wall from her map; mist rolls in and she and Kellan flee.
timeline.quote: The wall behind her vanished.

timeline.summary: Anim brings in two prisoners, Amalia and Kellan.
timeline.quote: We found these two running from the garrison

timeline.summary: Amalia says the other vampires killed their servants and the queen's emissary and are seeking Aclazotz.
timeline.quote: They killed our human servants and the queen's emissary, then escaped. They're looking for Aclazotz.

timeline.summary: Malcolm and Wayta reach Quint, Amalia, Kellan and Akal, and Malcolm reports the Mycotyrant.
timeline.quote: I am Steward Akal, and you seem to have brought us more trouble.

timeline.summary: Kellan beheads a vampire while Amalia looks away.
timeline.quote: bringing his sword together like scissors, Kellan took off her head.

timeline.summary: The Thousand Moons find the temple empty and Aclazotz gone.
timeline.quote: Aclazotz is gone

timeline.summary: Amalia tells Kellan she feels she has been living a lie about her faith.
timeline.quote: I feel as if I've been living a lie.

timeline.summary: Kellan and Amalia find an Omenpath.
timeline.quote: That's it. An Omenpath.

timeline.summary: Amalia chooses to leave her world with Kellan and they leap through the Omenpath.
timeline.quote: Without another word, they leaped through the Omenpath, and everything changed.

timeline.summary: Ezrim recounts how Investigator Kellan's team stopped the god Anzrag's rampage.
timeline.quote: a Gruul god broke loose of guild control and wreaked havoc across the Ninth District.

timeline.summary: Ezrim honors Kellan, who flees the balcony.
timeline.quote: The Agency thanks you, Ravnica thanks you, and I thank you

timeline.summary: Zegana mistakes Kellan for the detective Proft.
timeline.quote: Are you quite sure you're not that detective Proft everyone's been talking about?

timeline.summary: Kellan seeks out Kaya to escape the crowd and they bond over discomfort.
timeline.quote: Getting out of here

timeline.summary: Teysa presses Krenko about the debt he owes the Karlovs.
timeline.quote: Think, Krenko. You owe the Karlovs.

timeline.summary: Aurelia demands the Boros take over the investigation, provoking a scoff from Kellan.
timeline.quote: This investigation should be in the hands of the Boros.

timeline.summary: The Agency and Azorius search the sealed crime scene.
timeline.quote: Barrier wards had been deployed inside the scene

timeline.summary: The illusion ends as Etrata runs into Kellan, who restrains her.
timeline.quote: Etrata plowed directly into Kellan.

timeline.summary: Proft explains that his magic recreates anything he has seen.
timeline.quote: I make what's in here become out there, and I can recreate anything I've ever seen

timeline.summary: Proft persuades Kellan not to fight the Azorius over the suspect.
timeline.quote: This is not the time to stand our ground

timeline.summary: Lavinia demands that the suspect be remanded to Azorius custody and Etrata is taken away.
timeline.quote: Remand the suspect to Azorius custody at once

timeline.summary: Kellan finds Kaya at a coffee shop to summon her to Ezrim.
timeline.quote: it's the chief who'd like to speak to you

timeline.summary: Kellan tells Kaya that his father is the fae planeswalker Oko and asks if she knows him.
timeline.quote: His name's Oko

timeline.summary: Kaya pulls Kellan from an argument and he explains Etrata vanished from Azorius custody.
timeline.quote: Detective Proft went to speak with the prisoner in Azorius custody. When he got there, she was gone.

timeline.summary: Kaya tells Ezrim she now wants to lead the investigation.
timeline.quote: I would like to take point on this investigation.

timeline.summary: Kaya tells Ezrim that Teysa Karlov has been murdered.
timeline.quote: Teysa Karlov has been murdered.

timeline.summary: Kaya explains she cannot summon Teysa's ghost, who has warded her own soul.
timeline.quote: Teysa will appear when she wants to.

timeline.summary: Ezrim assigns Kellan to accompany Kaya.
timeline.quote: Inspector Kellan, you'll accompany her.

timeline.summary: Kellan shows Kaya the evidence vault, including the containment capsule holding the Gruul god.
timeline.quote: That's where we're containing the Gruul god we detained

timeline.summary: Kaya senses a ghost entering the building.
timeline.quote: A ghost just entered the building.

timeline.summary: Agrus Kos arrives, assigned by the Boros to work alongside the Agency.
timeline.quote: The Boros Legion has asked me to work alongside the Agency doing whatever they feel is necessary to catch the party or parties responsible.

timeline.summary: Kaya and Kellan head to Hellbender to find Judith.
timeline.quote: If we're going to speak with Judith, we need to head for Hellbender.

timeline.summary: Kaya intimidates the Rakdos doorman by letting him stab her intangible form.
timeline.quote: Can't stab what's not solid

timeline.summary: Judith makes a theatrical entrance on stage.
timeline.quote: Judith herself stepped around the curtain to center stage.

timeline.summary: Judith denies the murder, citing her verity circle and a dispute over interest rates with Teysa.
timeline.quote: I hardly think an argument over interest rates gives me cause to murder a Simic guildmaster

timeline.summary: Judith tells them to read the original Guildpact in Vitu-Ghazi.
timeline.quote: Go to Vitu-Ghazi. You need to read the Guildpact in its original form, and the tree shelters it.

timeline.summary: Kaya and Kellan leave as Judith looks smug.
timeline.quote: she looked smug, like everything was following her script once again.

timeline.summary: Kaya recalls Vitu-Ghazi's dormancy after the God-Eternals' damage and sets out with Kellan.
timeline.quote: When last Kaya had seen Vitu-Ghazi, the great living guildhall had been dormant

timeline.summary: A carriage driver reproaches Kaya for being absent during the Phyrexian invasion.
timeline.quote: And you could have been here when the Phyrexians came.

timeline.summary: Kellan reveals a friend came with him to Ravnica and is exploring the Rubblebelt.
timeline.quote: A friend of my own came with me.

timeline.summary: Kellan explains that Vitu-Ghazi was moved to the moor to recover after the invasion.
timeline.quote: Mat'Selesnya told Trostani that Vitu-Ghazi needed space to put down new root structures

timeline.summary: A massive white wolf charges Kaya and Kellan.
timeline.quote: A massive white wolf was loping toward them

timeline.summary: Kaya identifies the wolf as Voja and tells Kellan to defend only.
timeline.quote: His name is Voja.

timeline.summary: Tolsimir arrives and Kaya explains they are investigating Zegana's death.
timeline.quote: Inspector Kellan and I are investigating the matter of Zegana's death

timeline.summary: Tolsimir lowers a protective bubble so Kaya and Kellan can read the original Guildpact.
timeline.quote: A bubble of magical force surrounded an open book.

timeline.summary: Kaya reads that the founders bound the demon Rakdos to a people to contain his murderous influence over Ravnica.
timeline.quote: by binding the demon Rakdos to a people of his own, we can prevent his continuing to instill murderous rage in the citizens of Ravnica

timeline.summary: Kaya connects Etrata's missing memory to Rakdos's influence and resolves to report to Ezrim.
timeline.quote: We need to report this to Ezrim as soon as possible.

timeline.summary: Kaya notices a crowd shifting abnormally and realizes she and Kellan are being followed.
timeline.quote: We're being followed.

timeline.summary: Six robed attackers ambush Kaya and Kellan in an alley.
timeline.quote: A group of six people in long, dark robes followed them, too quickly to have arrived by accident, and fanned out to surround the pair.

timeline.summary: A captured attacker swallows a green sprout and the others do the same.
timeline.quote: he shoved something that looked like a tiny green sprout into his mouth, triumph lighting up his eyes as he swallowed.

timeline.summary: The attackers dissolve into moss, leaving empty robes.
timeline.quote: the flesh of the man in front of her softened and turned green, growing plush as it transmuted into moss beneath her hand.

timeline.summary: Kellan finds a tuft of white fur on the robe.
timeline.quote: A tuft of white fur tipped in gray clung to the fabric.

timeline.summary: An Agency thopter relays Ezrim's order to secure the scene and return.
timeline.quote: Boros officers are on their way to your location.

timeline.summary: Ezrim tells Kaya that Teysa's killer has been caught by the Azorius.
timeline.quote: Teysa's killer has been apprehended by the Azorius.

timeline.summary: Kaya realizes the arrest means Teysa is truly gone.
timeline.quote: having a killer means this isn't a trick. Teysa's really gone.

timeline.summary: Kellan shows Kaya his projektor and they review the evidence, doubting that Rakdos is behind the murders.
timeline.quote: I don't think Rakdos is behind this

timeline.summary: An alarm announces that the evidence locker has been compromised.
timeline.quote: Someone's compromised the evidence locker!

timeline.summary: Kellan identifies the creature as the Gruul harvest god Anzrag.
timeline.quote: The Gruul call him Anzrag

timeline.summary: Several agents are killed or injured as Anzrag rampages and Kaya leaps onto him.
timeline.quote: At least four people were down, two buried under chunks of masonry, one flattened by the god, and one sliced nearly in two by her claws.

timeline.summary: Kaya stabs Anzrag's nose while Kellan slashes his forelegs.
timeline.quote: Kaya struck him square in the middle of the tendril starburst, daggers biting deep.

timeline.summary: Ezrim challenges Anzrag while Kaya plans to use an evidence capsule.
timeline.quote: Ezrim was standing in the open space between the agent desks and the evidence pen

timeline.summary: Proft sets the jar before the assembled leaders to begin his presentation.
timeline.quote: He held up his jar, turning so that everyone would have a chance to see

timeline.summary: Tolsimir falsely confesses to the killings.
timeline.quote: I sent my most faithful to confront the Agency lackeys after they came here to consult the Guildpact.

timeline.summary: Thorny vines burst through the walls to seize the guild leaders.
timeline.quote: Thorny vines burst through the walls, grabbing for the assembled Ravnican leadership.

timeline.summary: Oba hoists Kaya and Kellan into the air as the ceiling opens.
timeline.quote: Above them, the ceiling opened like an iris, branches pulling apart to reveal an oblong section of sky.

timeline.summary: Oba throws Kaya and Kellan, separating them and sending Kellan spinning into the sky.
timeline.quote: The force of the throw separated her from Kellan, leaving him spinning away into the sky.

timeline.summary: Kellan is saved from the fall by gold-rimmed fae magic.
timeline.quote: pure, gold-rimmed fae magic of the same kind his hilts produced now enveloped him.

timeline.summary: Kaya leaves and finds Kellan unharmed outside, then cries for the first time since finding Teysa dead.
timeline.quote: In front of a very startled Kellan, she allowed herself to cry.

timeline.summary: Kaya tells Kellan she is leaving in the morning to help Tyvar hunt a dire bear, and learns Judith is still missing and Proft has hired Etrata.
timeline.quote: I'm heading out in the morning,

timeline.summary: Kellan works at the half-built relay tower in Omenport and reflects on the Omenpath that brought him from Eldraine.
timeline.quote: It was hard to believe it had only been a few weeks since he'd stepped through the portal.

timeline.summary: Kellan flies up on golden dust and catches the falling worker midair.
timeline.quote: Golden dust burst from his feet as he flew toward the man and wrapped his arms around him midair

timeline.summary: Kellan tells the worker that Ezrim told him his father was on this plane and that he is looking for him.
timeline.quote: My last boss, Ezrim—he told me my dad was on this plane.

timeline.summary: The overseer reassigns Kellan to Ral's security detail for a trip to Sterling Company headquarters in Prosperity.
timeline.quote: Mr. Zarek thinks someone with your skillset should be on his security detail instead of working out here in the heat.

timeline.summary: Kellan hopes someone in Prosperity can tell him about Oko and resolves to meet his father.
timeline.quote: The odds of at least someone in the city having information about Oko were bound to be high.

timeline.summary: Oko, leaving, meets Ral Zarek and Kellan on the road and senses Kellan's fae magic; his illusion collapses.
timeline.quote: Oko stiffened, and his illusion faded away without warning

timeline.summary: Kellan tells Oko he thinks Oko is his father, and that his mother is Alyse.
timeline.quote: "I think you're my father."

timeline.summary: Surrounded by Sterling guards, Oko is saved when Kellan throws the guards back with golden vine-shaped magic.
timeline.quote: Confusion swirled through Oko's mind until he realized the magic was coming from Kellan.

timeline.summary: Oko decides Kellan should join them, announcing that he is his son, over Vraska's objection.
timeline.quote: Besides, didn't you hear? He's my son.

timeline.summary: Oko decides having a son could be very useful.
timeline.quote: Oko decided that having a son could turn out to be very useful indeed.

timeline.summary: Oko tells Kellan he is glad to have met him and promises to teach him about his heritage.
timeline.quote: Now that we've finally been reunited, I can teach you so much about your true heritage.

timeline.summary: Kellan recognizes Ashiok, says they attacked his home and made Rowan Kenrith turn evil, but Oko tells him to trust him instead.
timeline.quote: They made Rowan Kenrith turn—well, evil!

timeline.summary: Kellan reluctantly agrees to help plan the capture after Oko promises no innocents will be harmed.
timeline.quote: "I promise that no innocents will be harmed."

timeline.summary: Kellan and Oko, disguised as Sterling guards, ride the train with Umezawa while the rest of the crew watches over a telepathic link.
timeline.quote: The moment Oko's voice pressed into Kellan's mind, he flinched.

timeline.summary: Gisa raises zombies too early, and Sterling guards find Kellan, Oko and Umezawa in the luggage car.
timeline.quote: "She raised the zombies too early," Geralf groaned.

timeline.summary: A fight in the luggage car leaves Umezawa wounded and two guards down.
timeline.quote: Oko moved swiftly, freeing a curved knife from his belt.

timeline.summary: Oko overrules Kellan about helping Umezawa and orders Annie to blow up the bridge.
timeline.quote: Oko's jaw tensed. "Take it out."

timeline.summary: The bridge explodes but the train does not slow, because the zombies have reached the conductor.
timeline.quote: The explosion was instant, echoing through the train walls and making the floor shake.

timeline.summary: Kellan and Oko cross the train roof, are attacked by Sterling guards, and are saved by Gisa's reanimated dead.
timeline.quote: Gray rotted arms closed around the guard's shoulders, and her weapon clattered to the ground.

timeline.summary: Oko disguises himself as a guard to lure away Nolan's escorts, and he and Kellan toss them off the train, capturing Nolan.
timeline.quote: give Graywater my regards.

timeline.summary: Annie arrives on Fortune and carries Nolan and Umezawa away from the train.
timeline.quote: Annie steered Fortune toward safety and broke into a fearless gallop

timeline.summary: Oko jumps off, abandoning the passengers, while Kellan follows and tries to stop the train with his vines.
timeline.quote: He leapt, tumbling across the sand with unsteady grace.

timeline.summary: Oko abandons Kellan as he struggles to hold the train at the cliff edge as the Sterling army approaches.
timeline.quote: With a final glance, he turned his back on Kellan and fled for the hills.

timeline.summary: Annie returns and holds off the Sterling riders while the passengers jump from the train.
timeline.quote: each of them nervously jumping for the desert floor before fleeing as far from the train as possible.

timeline.summary: Kellan releases his vines and the train plunges off the cliff and explodes; Annie and Kellan escape on Fortune.
timeline.quote: Kellan released his vines with a gasp, and the train shot over the edge of the cliff

timeline.summary: Kellan confronts Oko about the plan and Oko reassures him, claiming he trusted him to handle the train.
timeline.quote: you're my son, and I trust you.

timeline.summary: Annie and Kellan agree to escort Nolan to an oasis so he can make his way home.
timeline.quote: I can go with Kellan and escort the Outcaster to the nearest oasis.

timeline.summary: Annie tells Kellan how Akul hunted the Freestriders and injured her nephew, and why she cannot let him get the vault's power.
timeline.quote: A while back, I was with the Freestriders.

timeline.summary: Oko plans to enter Tarnation disguised as Hellspurs with Vraska, Annie and Kellan to reach Akul.
timeline.quote: We'll split up the team and take a small group of four into the city,

timeline.summary: Oko chooses Kellan as the fourth, privately noting that flattery keeps his son loyal.
timeline.quote: Flattery, it seemed, was the key to keeping his son on his side.

timeline.summary: The infiltration team enters Tarnation, where Hellspurs duel openly.
timeline.quote: A small crowd jeered and roared, and when one of the axes landed in the other man's chest, the onlookers raised their arms in triumph.

timeline.summary: Three Hellspurs rough up Kellan and Oko intervenes, sparking a saloon brawl in which Vraska turns one Hellspur to stone.
timeline.quote: and used her gaze to turn them to stone.

timeline.summary: Twist Fandango and Akul's inner circle capture Oko, Kellan, Annie and Vraska.
timeline.quote: clamping a pair of iron cuffs to his wrists.

timeline.summary: Akul confronts the chained crew, takes the sixth key from Oko and assembles the full key in his medallion.
timeline.quote: Akul slotted the sixth key into the medallion

timeline.summary: Kellan challenges Akul to a duel; Oko and the others goad Akul's pride until he agrees to a duel at midnight.
timeline.quote: The duel begins at midnight.

timeline.summary: At midnight Kellan is brought to Tarnation's dueling grounds, while Oko, Vraska and Annie are chained in the stands.
timeline.quote: Oko, Vraska, and Annie appeared, still bound in chains.

timeline.summary: Akul declares the duel a fight to the death.
timeline.quote: "This is a fight to the death!"

timeline.summary: Kellan dodges Akul's attacks, but his lasso and spear fail against the dragon's scales.
timeline.quote: Akul's scales were too thick to pierce.

timeline.summary: Cornered by Akul's thunder, Kellan taps an untouched fae power and lulls the dragon into a trance.
timeline.quote: The dragon lost focus, thunder spinning from his teeth in a harmless sigh.

timeline.summary: Kellan tries to choke the entranced Akul, but his guilt breaks the spell and Akul pins him.
timeline.quote: Kellan was wedged beneath him, unable to move.

timeline.summary: Kellan retrieves Akul's fallen medallion and tosses it to Oko.
timeline.quote: snatched the key from the ground, and tossed it back through the flames toward Oko's waiting hand.

timeline.summary: A Sterling guard knocks Kellan out as Oko leaves him behind.
timeline.quote: instead, Oko turned for the road and left his son behind.

timeline.summary: Oko admits to Annie and Vraska that he leaked Tarnation's coordinates to Graywater to use the raid as a distraction, and that he brought Kellan because he knew he would get them caught.
timeline.quote: I brought Kellan with us because I knew he'd get us caught.

timeline.summary: Kellan wakes in a Sterling prison carriage, realizing Oko left him behind.
timeline.quote: The truth stung more than any wound: Oko had left him behind.

timeline.summary: Ral Zarek knocks out the guards and frees Kellan from the carriage.
timeline.quote: He leaned forward and unlocked the cuffs from Kellan's wrists

timeline.summary: Ral says he wants the vault's power sealed away and proposes taking back the key and locking the treasure on another plane.
timeline.quote: We get the key back, find the treasure inside the vault, and lock it away on another plane

timeline.summary: Kellan joins Ral against Oko.
timeline.quote: "I'm with you," he said, unflinching.

timeline.summary: Kellan ropes Oko with a golden vine and Ral Zarek appears, confronting Vraska.
timeline.quote: A golden vine shot toward Oko's wrist, wrapping itself around his hand like a lasso.

timeline.summary: Kellan tells Oko he is his son, not crew, and Oko slams him to the ground with thorned vines after a race for the medallion.
timeline.quote: Oko barely flicked a finger, and the vines slammed Kellan against the ground with brute force.

timeline.summary: Annie shoots Oko, purposely missing, and Kellan uses his fae magic as Ashiok's nightmares overwhelm them.
timeline.quote: Shadows moved across the floor, wrapping around not only Kellan but Annie and Ral, too.

timeline.summary: Kellan wakes to find Vraska, Jace and the child gone and the vault collapsing, and rescues Annie.
timeline.quote: By the time he reached her side, Vraska, the man, and the child had vanished without a trace.

timeline.summary: The crew flees the collapsing vault on Rakdos's back.
timeline.quote: The team fled back through the corridor as the sound of the vault being ripped apart roared behind them.

timeline.summary: Akul seizes Annie, but Kellan takes control of the dragon's mind and orders him back into the collapsing vault.
timeline.quote: "Go back inside the vault—and don't come out."

timeline.summary: Rocks seal Akul inside, and the vault shoots into the clouds and vanishes.
timeline.quote: the vault shot toward the clouds and vanished from sight.

timeline.summary: Weeks later, Kellan works on Annie's ranch and Ral offers him a job on Ravnica, which he declines.
timeline.quote: "I think I've done enough wandering for a while,"

timeline.summary: Amalia arrives from Ravnica in answer to Kellan's invitation, and they embrace.
timeline.quote: "I missed you, Kellan,"

timeline.summary: Kellan gives Amalia flowers called meadowsweet from Lorwyn and mentions dreaming of them.
timeline.quote: Would you believe I dreamt of these a couple of nights ago?

timeline.summary: Kellan wakes from a dream of a rotting elder tree that screams like a human and writes down a woman's voice.
timeline.quote: And as the tree fell to the ground, it screamed .

timeline.summary: Kellan awakens on the third night and finds forget-me-nots blooming from his tongue.
timeline.quote: Forget-me-nots bloom from his tongue.

timeline.summary: Kellan coughs up a black flower while Amalia reads the dream journal, and later sees a woman's face in the mirror.
timeline.quote: A woman's face where his should be, surrounded by black flowers, eyes flashing and smiling.

relations.note: He teaches Boldt to ask rather than command magic.
relations.quote: Welcome...to the real academy, lad.

relations.note: Boldt was schooled in the art by him.
relations.quote: schooled in the art by Archmage Ghavos

relations.note: Ronald is Kellan's stepfather
relations.quote: And who you are is our boy.

relations.note: Ruby decides to help him on his quest
relations.quote: I guess someone's got to look out for you

relations.note: Peter offers to grant whatever Kellan asks and carries the cauldron
relations.quote: Whatever you ask of me, only speak it, and I will grant it

relations.note: Hired guide who helps them
relations.quote: Peter couldn't make it up the tree with his injuries, but he did give them all his savings so they could hire a guide.

relations.note: Ruby travels with and protects Kellan
relations.quote: And two fingers pinching the back of his cloak.

relations.note: She carries him through the blizzard
relations.quote: "People don't need to owe each other to help each other,"

relations.note: Peter equips and escorts them
relations.quote: Her brother drapes a bearskin around her shoulders

relations.note: Oko is Kellan's birth father
relations.quote: Oko. His father.

relations.note: Kellan's stepfather welcomes him home
relations.quote: "Honey! Honey, he's home, our boy's home!"

relations.note: Friends who fight together
relations.quote: The girl in red is swinging a sword twice her size at Eriette

relations.note: comforts him and tries to protect him
relations.quote: laying a hand on Kellan's shoulder

relations.note: escaped together
relations.quote: I'm Amalia, and this is Kellan

relations.note: bond over mutual discomfort
relations.quote: No wonder they honored you.

relations.note: Kellan thanks him for helping apprehend Etrata
relations.quote: Thank you for helping us apprehend this miscreant.

relations.note: new partners on the investigation
relations.quote: I guess we're partners now

relations.note: investigating partners
relations.quote: She gestured grandly for him to lead the way

relations.note: Kellan is Kaya's partner at the Agency.
relations.quote: hoping she wasn't going to step outside and find her partner smeared across the stones of the courtyard

relations.note: Oko is Kellan's father, though they have never met.
relations.quote: Besides, he was Oko's son, and that meant something.

relations.note: Oko recognizes Kellan as his son by Alyse.
relations.quote: Besides, didn't you hear? He's my son.

relations.note: Oko is Kellan's father.
relations.quote: Still, he followed his father downstairs

relations.note: Oko is Kellan's father and uses his need for approval.
relations.quote: all because Oko was family.

relations.note: Annie has helped Kellan twice and they grow close.
relations.quote: That's twice you've helped me. Thank you.

relations.note: Oko is Kellan's father, but abandons him.
relations.quote: Oko turned for the road and left his son behind.

relations.note: Oko is Kellan's father; Kellan says he is son, not crew.
relations.quote: "I'm not your crew; I'm your son."

relations.note: Ral and Kellan work together against Oko and Ral offers him a job.
relations.quote: I could really use someone I trust.

relations.note: Annie protects Kellan and he stays at her ranch.
relations.quote: I reckon they're worth protecting.

relations.note: Kellan blushes about expecting Amalia, and she says she missed him.
relations.quote: "I—I'm glad you're here."

pages_say.description: A young sorcerer, first son and heir to the Duchy of Kelsh, bound for the Tolarian Academy, who learns from Enthril that magic must be asked, not commanded.
A sixteen-year-old half-fae boy of Orrinshire, bullied for his faerie blood, who passes through the archway to meet Talion and accepts his quest.
A young half-fae hero on a quest for Talion, wielding a pair of fae-made basket hilts, who befriends Ruby.
A young half-fae hero who climbs a beanstalk to a giant's castle and is seized by Beluna.
A young half-fae hero who conjures a blade of light from his hilts, collapses from cold, and learns that Talion helped create the Wicked Slumber.
A young half-fae hero who confronts Eriette at Castle Ardenvale and learns from his mother that his father is Oko.
A pointed-eared swordsman from Eldraine with glowing twig-hilted blades, rescued by Amalia from pale goblin-like creatures.
A stranger traveling with the vampires who has been ambushed three times in one day.
A young man with golden-light twig-hilted swords who is searching for the father he has never met.
A pointy-eared young man who escaped with Amalia.
A young man from the fae realm searching for his father who fights beside Amalia and leaves through an Omenpath.
A slim, dark-haired Agency investigator honored for containing Anzrag, who befriends Kaya at the gala.
A young Agency investigator who catches the fleeing Etrata.
A young Agency investigator who fetches Kaya and asks if she knows his father, the planeswalker Oko.
A young half-fae Agency investigator who becomes Kaya's partner.
A cheerful young Agency investigator who wields woven-basket elemental swords and accompanies Kaya.
A young Agency investigator who fights with elemental swords and finds white fur on a dissolved attacker's robe.
A young Agency investigator who shows Kaya his projektor and fights Anzrag.
A young Agency investigator who guards Krenko and helps arrange the gathering.
A young Agency investigator hurled into the sky by Oba and saved by fae magic.
Kaya's young partner at the Agency, who survives being thrown off the roof by Oba.
A young fae from Eldraine working at Omenport who flew to catch a falling worker, and who is searching for his father Oko.
A young fae and Ral's bodyguard who reveals to Oko that he is his son and helps him escape.
A young fae and Oko's son who helps the crew but wants to save the train's passengers.
A young fae and Oko's son, who is uneasy about his father's methods and challenges Akul to a duel.
A young half-fae, half-human who duels Akul, discovers a dormant fae power, is abandoned by his father Oko and then joins Ral Zarek.
Oko's half-fae son who defeats Akul with mind control, rescues Annie, and later invites Amalia to Thunder Junction.
A young man with a whip of light magic who is courting Amalia and is haunted by dreams from Lorwyn after buying meadowsweet.
